items.memory: A Kestrel job that raises an error is retried three times, waiting 10, 60 and 300 seconds between attempts.
After its last retry fails, a Kestrel job moves to the kestrel-dlq queue and stays there until an operator requeues or deletes it.
Kestrel uses a short, fixed retry schedule rather than exponential backoff so that an operator can tell from the clock alone when a job will run again.
